subject: fork-collapse-review
summary: The collapse review recognizes this repository as a local fork of @colbymchenry/codegraph whose reason to exist is the Era adapter (ERB + ontology CSV + engine profile); everything serving upstream publication is dead weight here and is deleted: the site, telemetry worker, installers, CI workflows, the 205-file upstream test suite with its eval harness, release/packaging scripts, the Rust kernel experiment with its four vendored grammar trees, 22 vendored language wasms outside the workspace's real set (python, typescript, tsx, javascript, rust, c, cpp — missing languages degrade gracefully because the registry loads per file and skips on failure), the upstream docs except docs/era.md, and the 861-line upstream README. The single witness (npm run witness) builds a real index of this repository's own src and resolves a known symbol through the CLI; nodejs-lts is installed side-by-side because the machine's default Node 26 crashes tree-sitter WASM compilation. CLAUDE.md collapses to an @AGENTS.md import so the one-screen entry is the only authority.

subject: local-consumer-boundary
summary: The installed codegraph command and Codex MCP entry prove the CLI, MCP server, and agent-config installer are live local consumers. Remote update checks, self-upgrade, telemetry, and beta signup are not part of indexing or query and could replace the Era adapter with an upstream release, so those paths are removed. The installer is retained only for local agent configuration and uninstall cleanup. Builds now clean dist first so deleted publication modules cannot survive as stale package output.

subject: deployed-era-adapter
summary: The verified build was deployed to the codegraph command used by the Codex MCP entry. The deployed package contains the emuera-1824-ee55 engine profile and exposes neither telemetry nor self-upgrade commands. Re-indexing the existing eym graph produced 1,524 files: 1,239 erabasic, 283 eracsv, and 2 xml; explore returned ERB source, CSV-bound variable reads and writes, and synthesized dynamic call paths.
